submitted.rationale: XRD showed two phases along the line. A Bi2O3-like phase (Q≈2.00, 2.32, 3.27) dominates at low Sb. A fluorite-like Bi–Sb–O phase (Q≈1.874, 2.372, 2.649, 3.553) is single-phase from about 50% Sb upward. For EQE at 2.4 eV, the Bi-rich end (idx 3) gave 1.44e-4 %. The Sb-rich single phase (idx 25) gave about zero. The two-phase region (idx 11, Sb≈0.18), where the Bi2O3-like phase shows a lattice shift from Sb, gave the highest value: 1.49e-4 %.
